title: POTSA: A CROSS-LINGUAL SPEECH ALIGNMENT FRAMEWORK FOR LOW RESOURCE SPEECH-TO-TEXT TRANSLATION

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring Speech-to-Text Translation (S2TT) performance disparities across high-resource, low-resource, and zero-shot source languages using BLEU scores, and evaluating cross-lingual speech representation consistency using Recall@1 and Jensen-Shannon Divergence (JSD).
